enemy.name: OpFor: Armor
enemy.flavour_text:
Steam armor thoroughly corrupted by Originium, an OpFor unit based on the scenario of a Terra-wide Originium disaster. As Originium spreads, courage, resolve and glory are turned to crystalline dust, leaving behind the armor, torn apart by crystals to march towards the fading light of the sunset.
Appears during the Hidden Core round and initiates the final attack.

abilities.text: Randomly selects a target and performs an Arts attack
When HP drops below a certain percentage, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced, and [Woe of Extinction] fires additional <Armor Piercer>

[Woe of Extinction] Fires an <Armor Piercer> at the Operator with the highest ATK within range, which explodes when it reaches the target, stunning them and units in the 8 surrounding tiles and causing them to take Physical damage every second; <Armor Piercer> can be destroyed by attacking it several times when it is flying
[Sword and Hammer of Olden Days] OpFor: Armor enters its final form after fulfilling specific conditions and entering the Hidden Core round
